supporting_pages.title: Size and position page elements \_|\_ Apps Script \_|\_ Google for Developers
evidence_snippets: In Apps Script, use: setTransform() to set the affine transform of page elements (similar to ABSOLUTE mode); preconcatenateTransform() to pre-concatenate an affine transform to the current transform of page elements (similar to RELATIVE mode).
In Apps Script, use: getInherentWidth() and getInherentHeight() for the inherent (native) size of page elements; getTransform() for the affine transform of the page elements.
